definitions.explanation: Any liquid that can be drunk.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{物|もの}は{何|なに}がいいですか。
examples.english: What would you like to drink?

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{物|もの}を{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
{暑|あつ}い{日|ひ}は{冷|つめ}たい{飲|の}み{物|もの}がおいしい。
examples.english: Cold drinks taste good on hot days.

examples.japanese: パーティーのために、{飲|の}み{物|もの}と{食|た}べ{物|もの}をたくさん{用意|ようい}した。
examples.english: I prepared a lot of drinks and food for the party.

notes:
{飲|の}み{物|もの} is the standard general word for any drink or beverage. It covers everything from water and tea to alcohol.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {冷|つめ}たい{飲|の}み{物|もの}: cold drink
- {温|あたた}かい{飲|の}み{物|もの}: warm/hot drink
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}は{何|なに}がいいですか: What would you like to drink?
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}を{注文|ちゅうもん}する: to order a drink

WORD FORMATION:
Follows the verb-stem + {物|もの} pattern, meaning "something to [verb]":
- {飲|の}み{物|もの}: something to drink
- {食|た}べ{物|もの}: something to eat
- {読|よ}み{物|もの}: reading material
- {買|か}い{物|もの}: shopping

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ドリンク: drink (loanword, often used in menus and product names)
- {飲料|いんりょう}: beverage (more formal/written, as in {飲料水|いんりょうすい} — drinking water)
